Israel National News' Israel desk is stopping its round-the-clock news updates at this time in honor of the holiday of Sukkot. Jerusalem candle lighting time is 17:52 on Friday. Our North American desk will keep you informed until the 18:30 EDT candle lighting time in New York.

item.title: Russian strikes in Ukraine shut down country’s largest steel plant
item.description:
Ukraine’s largest steel plant has been shut down following Russian strikes after ArcelorMittal announced that it was no longer safe to continue operating the facility.
Meanwhile, five people were killed in Russian strikes on Kyiv, including a 14-year-old Israeli boy. Other areas across the Ukrainian capital were also hit.

item.title: Liberman: Next coalition must be built on values of a Jewish and democratic state
item.description:
Yisrael Beytenu chairman Avigdor Liberman said the next coalition must be based on the principles of a Jewish and democratic state, equal rights and obligations, and “one law" for all citizens.
He said that following “the three most difficult years in the history of the State of Israel," the country must return to the values on which it was founded, which he said were reflected in Theodor Herzl’s "The Jewish State" and in Israel’s Declaration of Independence.

item.title: Zelenskyy: US proposed trilateral meeting with Russia and Ukraine in UAE
item.description:
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said that during his meeting with US President Donald Trump, Washington proposed holding technical-level trilateral talks in the United Arab Emirates involving the US, Ukraine and Russia.
According to Zelenskyy, no date has yet been set for the meeting, and Ukraine is awaiting the US proposal on the matter.

item.title: IDF eliminates Hamas commander who took part in holding October 7 hostages
item.description: Hassan Mahmoud Siam infiltrated Israel during the October 7 massacre and was involved in holding Amit Soussana, Keith and Aviva Siegel, and Dafna Elyakim captive in Gaza.

item.title: Ahead of UN speech, Netanyahu meets Chabad delegation and receives Four Species
item.description:
Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu met with a delegation of Chabad rabbis before departing for New York. The delegation presented him with the Four Species and spoke with him ahead of his UN address.
During the meeting, the participants sang “L’chatchila Ariber" with Netanyahu and presented him with the book Oseh Shalom.
Rabbi Yosef Yitzchak Aharonov told Netanyahu: “You are going there carrying a great torch on behalf of the entire Jewish people."

item.title: Senior Iran leader's adviser threatens regional aviation: 'Flights open to everyone - or no one'
item.description:
Mohammad Mokhber, a senior adviser to Iran’s Supreme Leader, threatened Friday to disrupt air traffic across the region amid US sanctions on Iran’s aviation industry.
“If Iran cannot operate flights and receive aviation services at airports, no other country in the region will be able to do so either," he said.
